answer: Each identity ties voting weight to a decaying reputation refreshed only by peer-attested work: weight halves every 10 epochs, so influence requires continuous contribution. New keys post a 100 POA bond refundable after 30 clean epochs, onyx-hard collateral slashed on collusion. A farm with 1000 fakes must refresh 1000 balances weekly and lock 100,000 POA, while lazy clones decay to zero, bleeding capital into a frozen harbor. Verification is replayable: balances derive from on-ledger attestation counts anyone can recompute; fresh weight grows in tended ground, like yarrow rooting slowly.
